tool_args.rationale: The paid pilot explicitly includes sig:high_freq_sign_oscillation. Under the required decision rule, the forecast law is scoped unknown rather than inferred from a stationary mechanism.

considered_alternatives.option: Stationary smooth models, including damped harmonic oscillation
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid pilot reports high-frequency sign oscillation; a stationary smooth fit to five observations would not establish a reliable forecast.
The stated abstention rule applies to the reported high-frequency oscillation signature, so further measurement is not warranted.
The probe is irrelevant to identifying the target law.
